means: The character's eyes meet the camera. Danbooru's direct-address tag - the anime equivalent of breaking the fourth wall by an inch.
does: Turns the head and eyes toward the lens and holds the gaze there. It is one of the most heavily labelled attributes in the entire danbooru vocabulary and correspondingly obedient - it lands when subtler face tags do not. Dramatically it converts an observed moment into a confronted one: the same face that reads as private in three-quarter reads as a challenge once it looks down the barrel. Use it on purpose, not as filler.
reach_for_it: reaction shots, direct address, and any beat where a character is squaring up to whoever is on the other side of the lens
used_in: the eyes field of emotions/neutral.json, smug, suspicion and tender, which compile.py expands into the beat tags - that is how it reaches the prompt. Visible in the compiled locker-room beats of derby-ep1.json
example_base: 1boy, solo, male focus, short black hair, dark jacket, standing on a rooftop, city skyline behind, late afternoon sun, looking away, masterpiece, best quality, very aesthetic, absurdres
read_it_as: Compare the SHADING, colour and line - not the pose or framing. Adding any clause re-rolls the model's conditioning, so composition moves between the two panels even at a fixed seed. An img2img pass from one fixed base image would isolate the tag properly; that is not built yet.
